method: Three independent, manually targeted mutation passes after five-pass review convergence. This is not an exhaustive mutation score.
execution: Each single mutant ran against the complete unit suite or complete acceptance self-test suite, in an isolated checkout with verified local imports. Original bytes were restored and SHA-256 checked after every mutant. New tests were copied only after each original campaign ended, then a green full baseline preceded each full-suite survivor retest.
infrastructure: Two initial sandbox baselines could not bind local fixture sockets. They were rerun successfully with loopback access and were not counted as mutation results.
